rules.name: precompile-address-case
rules.message: This QoreChain precompile address is written in mixed case.

rules.name: precompile-empty-return
rules.message: A low-level call to a precompile uses the return data without checking its length. An inactive precompile returns success with empty data.
rules.fix: Check that the return data is long enough before decoding it, and treat empty data as a failure.

rules.name: pqc-key-status-unchecked
rules.message: The result of pqcKeyStatus is used without checking both registered and possessionProven.
rules.fix: Require registered and possessionProven before trusting the key.

rules.name: pqc-verify-result-ignored
rules.message: The return value of pqcVerify is not checked.
rules.fix: Require the pqcVerify result to be true before acting on the signature.

rules.name: bridge-call-kind
rules.message: The cross-VM bridge is called with staticcall, delegatecall or value.
rules.fix: Call the bridge with a plain call and no value.

rules.name: bridge-payload-concat
rules.message: A bridge payload is built by concatenating a string or bytes parameter that this function does not validate.
rules.fix: Validate or escape the parameter in the same function before it goes into the payload.

rules.name: pqc-message-unbound
rules.message: The message checked by pqcVerify does not bind block.chainid, address(this) or a changing counter, so a signature can be replayed.
rules.fix: Include block.chainid, address(this) and a nonce that changes on every use in the signed message.

rules.name: value-to-precompile
rules.message: Value is sent to a precompile address.
rules.fix: Do not send value to precompile addresses.
